items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Beal had joined the band on piano

ctx.x: Okay, so they agreed to pay us the $40.00. Well, they paid us the $40.00, and then after this we went on back to Chicago, and when we went back to Chicago, this is when the band broke up.
But before, Teddy Wilson had left the band, and Charlie Beal had joined the band on piano --
